title: Add Steam Deals Web localhost smoke test
acceptance_criteria: `python3 .tmp/local-smoke-tests/steam_web_smoke.py` exits 0 after starting Steam Deals Web and verifying a bounded localhost readiness check.
The smoke test only calls localhost endpoints and does not depend on Steam, GitHub, or other remote services.
The smoke test terminates any process it started before exit, including timeout and failure paths.
Failure output is actionable and identifies the localhost endpoint or process state that did not become ready.
completion_summary: Se agrego smoke local de Steam Deals Web con readiness localhost y cierre limpio.
